finding.gap: TurnLifecycle.complete() canonicalized Stop/assistant output without revalidating the active turn generation inside its own write transaction. A recovery generation advance between provider/Stop-side checks and completion commit could therefore admit a stale response.
finding.repair: Call assert_live_generation(session_id, active_turn.generation) inside the existing UnifiedDB BEGIN IMMEDIATE completion transaction before workspace selection, assistant insertion or causal completion.
finding.scope: General canonical TurnLifecycle Stop/completion path; independent of Mistral transport/provider architecture.

red_gate.intervention: Begin a canonical turn at generation 1, advance the single global entity generation to 2 before Stop, then call complete().
red_gate.required: StaleGeneration; no assistant turn; no causal episode; stale active turn remains available for canonical recovery rather than being falsely completed.

promotion_gate: Execute the exact focused red gate and adjacent TurnLifecycle/recovery regressions on a freshly bound authorized isolated source checkout, then continue through the owner-mandated exact OCI/Firecracker/Vault-Mistral test-of-tests.
